response.query: What are the top creative and quality trends in Health & Medical Sciences for AI ethics education, based on discussed ideas like fairness metrics, multilingual NLP, artifact scoring, mitigation strategies, and governance safeguards?
response.answer: Top trends in Health & Medical Sciences for AI ethics education include fairness metrics, multilingual NLP, and governance safeguards. Emphasis on mitigation strategies and artifact scoring is also crucial. These focus on ensuring equitable, safe, and responsible AI use in healthcare.

results.title: International AI Safety Report 2025
results.content: **AI developers have rapidly improved the capabilities of general-purpose AI in recent years, mostly through ‘scaling’.**([See Chair’s update on the latest AI advances](https://internationalaisafetyreport.org/publication/international-ai-safety-report-2025#291)). *   **The pace of advancement in general-purpose AI creates an ‘evidence dilemma’ for decision-makers.**([See Chair’s update on the latest AI advances](https://internationalaisafetyreport.org/publication/international-ai-safety-report-2025#291)).Rapid capability advancement makes it possible for some risks to emerge in leaps; for example, the risk of academic cheating using general-purpose AI shifted from negligible to widespread within a year. results.title: Systematic literature review on bias mitigation in generative AI
results.content: ### Ethical AI Development: Mitigating Bias in Generative Models. **Search Terms**—We carried out a search for scientific documentation in Google Scholar, IEEE, Science Direct, Scopus and Library databases using keywords associated with Bias in Generative AI (Artificial Intelligence OR Generative AI OR Machine Learning OR various biases in AI OR Generative AI models OR Survey on ChatGPT OR Dalle OR Different types of bias in Generative OR what are sources of bias in Generative AI OR different methodologies to mitigate bias in AI OR what is bias in AI OR Bias in Machine Learning OR what is fairness OR how can we quantify fairness OR categorise of different bias OR Gender Inequality in Machine Learning survey in fairness in Machine Learning OR what are different methods incorporate to mitigate the bias OR what are the effects of bias in AI OR what are the Machine Biases OR what are the causes of bias OR what are the factors for bias in AI OR algorithms used in bias mitigation OR how to remove bias from AI OR fairness and bias in AI OR reducing bias in AI/ML OR bias classification OR Survey on Gender Bias OR Bias in generative AI in images OR real examples of bias in AI. In conclusion, achieving effective bias mitigation in generative AI (GAI) systems requires a comprehensive, multi-dimensional approach to ensure fairness, inclusivity, and accountability across varied modalities, including text, audio, video, image, and code.
